reviews.text: every high school english teacher had an aneurism a minute into the movie after reading “source: wikipedia”
i know that describing a movie as “reddit” is super tired and overused at this point but

A really fun time with the right crowd, but not as funny as I hoped it would be. It was more gore than I thought, though, so that’s a plus. 

I wish they would have had less character development and more goofiness.

A marketing masterpiece that tricked people into seeing a lifeless movie with the only intention of making money. It takes full advantage of the meme generation with its crazy concept, but sadly, the concept is the only bright spot if there’s any at all. If only real talent was involved in the project. A tragedy that this is one of Ray Liotta’s final performances, as it’s both a horrible film but a disrespectful scene to be one of his last, a spit in the face to his entire career. The audacity to dedicate this garbage to him. Left a very bad taste in my mouth leaving the theaters. Will 100% be a big hit with the crowd that watches 5 movies a year. A movie only funny and entertaining to those who don’t deem cinema as an art form.
we can only hope that this marks the beginning of a franchise where different animals take different drugs. really looking forward to LSD cow.
